description: The code that owns network access: a shared API client plus per-feature resource definitions. Components consume it and never call `fetch`.
One module with the base URL, headers, authentication and error mapping. Lives in `shared/api` because it has no business knowledge.
A typed error thrown for every non-2xx response, carrying `status`, so the UI can branch on it without seeing a `Response`.
An object per feature (`productQueries`) whose functions return `queryOptions` with hierarchical keys built from one root.
TanStack Query helper that returns its argument (typed), so a key, its `queryFn` and its options are defined once and reused by hooks, prefetching and cache reads.
